extraction_scope: Worker-6 adjudicated mechanism claims from primary text, figures/captions, and supplementary method text; unsupported molecular-target claims were not promoted.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: WR12 and D-IK8 directly permeabilize staphylococcal membranes in calcein leakage assays, with WR12 stronger than D-IK8 under the reported MRSA USA300 conditions.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Direct membrane permeabilization evidence; no single protein or molecular target is assigned.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: At sub-inhibitory peptide concentrations, VRSA resensitization is supported by membrane permeabilization context and increased bodipy-vancomycin binding/uptake assays.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: WR12 and D-IK8 against VRSA/VRS10 context
mechanism_claims.limitations: Mechanism is framed as increased antibiotic access/permeabilization; downstream resistance pathways are not resolved.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Biofilm disruption, persister/stationary-phase killing, intracellular killing, and mouse skin-lesion reductions are phenotypic efficacy outcomes consistent with membrane-active AMPs but are not standalone direct molecular-target evidence.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Recorded as efficacy/mechanism-context evidence, not as proof of a specific intracellular target.
